name: free-tier-quota-probe
description: Quota-limit observability probe for free-tier serverless DBs (Supabase/Neon/Turso/D1): fill to the wall, capture the failure form, probe survival, run recovery recipes, verify integrity.
comment: Reuses the serverless-db-bench (Q3) stack. D1 uses native fetch (no package). Turso: @libsql/client works on hosted free; @tursodatabase/serverless is the newer recommended SDK — pick at Phase 0 (see PREREGISTRATION 'Facts pending').
